Module unibl.etf.pj2.epj2.epj2

Package unibl.etf.pj2.epj2.epj2.controller

package unibl.etf.pj2.epj2.epj2.controller
Package unibl.etf.pj2.epj2.epj2.controller This package contains all the controller classes for the application's GUI. Each controller class manages the interactions between the user interface and the application's business logic, handling events, updating views, and managing user input. Packages and classes included in this package are: - EPJ2ViewController: The controller for the main window of the application, enabling navigation between different views. - MapViewController: The controller for the map view, managing the simulation and displaying the current state on the map. - HighestExpenseViewController: The controller for displaying the vehicles with the highest expenses, serializing and deserializing vehicle data. - FailuresViewController: The controller for displaying vehicle failures. - BusinessReportsViewController: The controller for displaying business reports. - VehiclesViewController: The controller for displaying vehicle information. These controllers interact with models and services in the application to provide appropriate data for display and process user actions efficiently.
